about: Big unlocks for the quest path. Each 'unlocks' line was confirmed on the RuneScape Wiki page in source_url on checked_date. final_quest must match the wiki's quest page name.

unlocks.name: Prifddinas
unlocks.unlocks: Access to the city of Prifddinas (quest rewards list), plus 50,000 XP lamps in 10 skills
unlocks.why_it_matters: Corrupted ore for Mining and Smithing, and the crystal hammer, are in Prifddinas

unlocks.name: Vibrant energy money method
unlocks.unlocks: Listed as a quest requirement for harvesting vibrant energy (4.32M gp/hr)
unlocks.why_it_matters: Your Path C question; it also needs the Divine Conversion relic

unlocks.name: Superheat Form and Crystal Mask
unlocks.unlocks: Superheat Form (elder rune bar guide) and Crystal Mask (skilling money guide)
unlocks.why_it_matters: Faster smelting, and longer AFK pickpocketing

unlocks.name: Lletya animica mine
unlocks.unlocks: The Lletya mine (light animica) lists Regicide as its requirement
unlocks.why_it_matters: A third light animica mine for Path A

unlocks.name: Lunar spells and the astral rift
unlocks.unlocks: The astral rift in the Abyss; also a requirement for crafting decorated urns on the Lunar spellbook (skilling money guide)
unlocks.why_it_matters: Runecrafting through the Abyss, and a 13.85M gp/hr money method (which also needs Plague's End)

unlocks.name: Elder wisps (Elder Halls)
unlocks.unlocks: Training on elder wisps in the Elder Halls from 75 Divination
unlocks.why_it_matters: A Divination alternative to the Hall of Memories

unlocks.name: Death rift
unlocks.unlocks: The death rift in the Abyss
unlocks.why_it_matters: Also step 7 of the Plague's End chain

unlocks.name: Vyre pickpocketing (Darkmeyer)
unlocks.unlocks: Quest requirement for pickpocketing vyrelord and vyrelady consumers (5.03M gp/hr, needs 118 Thieving)
unlocks.why_it_matters: The best low-intensity Thieving money method once you reach 118
